waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
A Halloween and fall weekend full of treats, scares, and local fun for everyone.

🎃 *Sat 6 AM* — Tesoro Monster Bash ($0–$1068.91)
   Right in Tesoro—costumes, candy, community.
👻 *Sat 4 PM* — Mall-o-Ween Trick-or-Treating! (free)
   Trick-or-treating at the mall, no traffic chaos.
🏃 *Sat 3:30 PM* — Halloween Scavenger Hunt, Parade and Stories (free)
   Halloween scavenger hunt keeps kids engaged.
🌺 *Fri 8 PM* — Eternamente: A Dia De Los Muertos Spectacular!
   Live performance celebrating Día de Los Muertos.
🎃 *Sun 9 AM* — Gilchrist Farm Harvest Festival & Pumpkin Patch (free)
   Pumpkin patch and festival, perfect fall day out.
🎸 *Sun 1 PM* — Afternoon Acoustic Jam (free)
   Free live music for adults looking to unwind.
🥕 *Sun 8 AM* — Santa Clarita Certified Farmers Market (free)
   Sunday farmers market, local vendors and fresh food.

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
